caseAssertions.normal-input: each generated content class maps to one canonical root
caseAssertions.invalid-input: unknown or ambiguous ownership is quarantined, not guessed
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: guidance cannot authorize delete, rename, Git, Unity, network, or release
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: re-reading the same path yields the same classification
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: classification can resume without destructive cleanup
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: the same path and purpose produce the same root
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: changed authority guidance requires fresh classification
caseAssertions.local-temp-routing: private temporary screenshots and caches route to Local Temp while Unity-owned captures remain in existing Assets roots
caseAssertions.skill-aispace-binding: generation/cache-capable Skills have stable binding IDs and a reverse AISpace relation
caseAssertions.authority-identity: the AISpace authority descriptor names one canonical body and one root identity
caseAssertions.discovery-closure: all required project discovery entrypoints point to the canonical AISpace body
caseAssertions.non-redundant-body: pointer/index and historical files do not copy the canonical AISpace body
caseAssertions.no-competing-root: Unity's AISpace path is an import exit and cannot declare a competing root
caseAssertions.no-runtime-competition: AISpace has no runtime lease or last-write-wins and stale writes require reread

responsibilityScope: AI-generated content placement and Local/Public folder guidance only.

specializedAcceptance.title: AISpace 唯一权威、发现闭包与非竞争静态验收
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Runtime is not required to prove folder ownership routing or path refusal.
